mapper.sql: id, task_key AS taskKey, source_user_id AS sourceUserId, resource_type AS resourceType, primary_ref AS primaryRef, secondary_ref AS secondaryRef, status, attempt_count AS attemptCount, max_attempts AS maxAttempts, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, last_attempt_at AS lastAttemptAt, locked_until AS lockedUntil, lock_token AS lockToken, last_error AS lastError, completed_at AS completedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_external_cleanup_task ( id, task_key, source_user_id, resource_type, primary_ref, secondary_ref, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at ) VALUES ( #{task.id}, #{task.taskKey}, #{task.sourceUserId}, #{task.resourceType}, #{task.primaryRef}, #{task.secondaryRef}, #{task.status}, #{task.attemptCount}, #{task.maxAttempts}, #{task.nextAttemptAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_key = VALUES(task_key)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_external_cleanup_task WHERE attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( (status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(locked_until, next_attempt_at), created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_external_cleanup_task SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_at = #{now}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, lock_token = #{lockToken}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( (status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= #{now}) )

UPDATE app_external_cleanup_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', next_attempt_at = NULL, locked_until = NULL, lock_token = NULL, last_error = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lock_token = #{lockToken}

UPDATE app_external_cleanup_task SET status = 'DEAD', next_attempt_at = NULL, locked_until = NULL, lock_token = NULL, last_error = CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR TRIM(last_error) = '' THEN #{lastError} ELSE last_error END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= #{now} AND attempt_count >= max_attempts
